item.title: backlog history table misaligns on long titles — no truncation applied
item.intent: The 'backlog history' table must truncate titles to 40 characters with an ellipsis, matching the truncation already applied in 'status' recent sprints, so the table columns stay aligned regardless of title length.
item.description: cmd_backlog_history renders title using '%s' with no truncation (lines ~4794, 4801). Any title longer than ~30 chars pushes all subsequent columns right, misaligning ID, date, status, and duration. _status_output at line 3603 already does this correctly: '(.title // "-") | if length > 40 then .[:40] + "…" else . end'. The history command needs the same treatment.
steps: In the jq filter inside cmd_backlog_history (both the --all path and the default path), replace '.title // "-"' with '((.title // "-") | if length > 40 then .[:40] + "…" else . end)'
Verify the table renders correctly with a long title (>40 chars)
Verify the table renders correctly with a short title (<40 chars)
Run shellcheck and confirm zero new warnings
acceptanceCriteria: A title longer than 40 characters is truncated to 40 chars + ellipsis in history output
A title of 40 characters or fewer is displayed unchanged
Table columns (ID, DATE, STATUS, DURATION) stay aligned regardless of title length
shellcheck passes with zero new warnings
